altitude.title: High Altitude = Clean Flavor
altitude.description: Grown at 1,300–1,500 meters in Chiang Mai. Higher altitude means slower cherry growth — which means denser beans and better sweetness.

freshness.title: Fresh Roast Policy
freshness.description: We roast in small batches. Every bag clearly shows roast date. No warehouse-old coffee.

direct.title: Direct Pricing — No Middleman
direct.description: We sell direct from roaster to you. That’s why our price is fair — without sacrificing quality.

Wholesale.title: Wholesale Coffee – Stable Quality, Stable Profit
Wholesale.perfectFor: Perfect for: Small cafes, Home cafe sellers, Online resellers, Office coffee supply

moq.a: Start with 500g sample (350฿). For bulk: 5kg minimum at 599฿/kg for volume discounts.

profit.q: What profit margin can I expect?
profit.a: Resell at 1,000–1,200฿/kg. Average margin: 400–600฿ per kg. Many cafes charge 45–60฿ per cup (250ml) for 18–25g per serving.

consistency.q: Is the roast consistent batch to batch?
consistency.a: Yes. We roast to specification and test every batch. Minor variations in taste are normal with fresh roasting — part of the premium experience.

supply.a: We maintain stock. Average turnaround: 2–3 days for orders. For ongoing contracts, we offer dedicated supply agreements.

packaging.a: Yes. Minimum 50kg for custom labels. Standard valve bags provided as default. Ask on LINE for branding options and pricing.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Bank transfer (Thai banking hours), Promptpay QR code, Cash on delivery (Chiang Mai area), or LINE Pay. Ask K. Jen (089-8556550) for details.

freshness.a: Best within 30 days from roast date. We recommend storing in an airtight container.

storage.a: Keep sealed. Avoid sunlight and humidity. A cool, dry place is best.

grind.a: Yes — tell us your preferred brewing method (Drip, Espresso, Moka pot, etc.) when ordering on LINE.

shipping.a: Yes, we ship all across Thailand via Flash, J&T, or Kerry.
